record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.original_question: Construct an algorithm that gives a rigorous upper bound for the topological entropy of a real Hénon map f_{c,b}|_{R^2}.

evidence.quote: Question 29. — Construct an algorithm to compute a rigorous upper bound for the topological entropy of a real Hénon map fc,b|R2.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For real parameters $c \in \mathbb{R}$ and $b \in \mathbb{R} \setminus \{0\}$, consider the real Hénon map
$$f_{c,b} : \mathbb{R}^2 	o \mathbb{R}^2, \qquad f_{c,b}(x,y) = (x^2 + c - by,\; x).$$
Let $K \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ denote the set of points whose forward and backward orbits under $f_{c,b}$ are bounded; the restriction $f_{c,b}|_K$ is a homeomorphism of a compact set, and its topological entropy $h_{\mathrm{top}}(f_{c,b}|_{\mathbb{R}^2}) := h_{\mathrm{top}}(f_{c,b}|_K)$ is defined as
$$h_{\mathrm{top}}(f_{c,b}|_K) = \lim_{\varepsilon 	o 0} \limsup_{n 	o \infty}  rac{1}{n} \log s(n,\varepsilon),$$
where $s(n,\varepsilon)$ is the maximal cardinality of an $(n,\varepsilon)$-separated set with respect to the dynamical metric $d_n(x,y) = \max_{0 \le k \le n-1} \|f_{c,b}^k(x) - f_{c,b}^k(y)\|$.

Problem: Design an explicit algorithm that, given as input rational (or interval) values of the parameters $c$ and $b$, terminates and outputs a real number $H(c,b)$ which is a rigorous (i.e., mathematically certified) upper bound for $h_{\mathrm{top}}(f_{c,b}|_{\mathbb{R}^2})$.
artifact.status_search_result: Rigorous algorithms exist for computing rigorous lower bounds on the topological entropy of real Hénon maps (Day–Frongillo–Trevino; Arai), and general frameworks (Froyland–Junge–Ochs) give rigorous upper bounds for entropy with respect to a fixed partition. However, a general rigorous algorithm producing certified upper bounds for the full topological entropy of arbitrary real Hénon maps does not appear to be established in the literature; the problem is widely cited as open with only partial progress.

status_evidence.title: Topological Entropy Bounds for Hyperbolic Plateaus of the Hénon Map
status_evidence.snippet: Combining rigorous computational methods for verifying hyperbolicity (Arai) and for computing topological entropy bounds (Day et al.), lower bounds on topological entropy were proven for 43 hyperbolic plateaus of the Hénon map.
status_evidence.claim: Rigorous lower bounds on Hénon entropy have been established, indicating only partial progress toward rigorous upper bounds.

status_evidence.title: Rigorous computation of topological entropy with respect to a finite partition
status_evidence.snippet: A method to compute rigorous upper bounds for the topological entropy h(T,A) of a continuous map T with respect to a fixed partition A.
status_evidence.claim: Rigorous upper bounds for entropy relative to a partition exist; full topological entropy upper bounds for Hénon remain a separate question.

status_evidence.title: Algorithms for Rigorous Entropy Bounds and Symbolic Dynamics
status_evidence.snippet: Applying the method to the Hénon map yields a rigorous lower bound for topological entropy of 0.4320.
status_evidence.claim: State-of-the-art rigorous results for Hénon focus on lower bounds.
